description: Resolve a Japanese company to its EDINET code and securities code from the FSA's official EDINET filer list — the lookup every other EDINET call needs. Searches Japanese name, English name, kana, EDINET code and ticker across ~11,000 filers, and returns industry, listing status, fiscal year end and corporate number. Needs no API key. Example: edinet_search_filers({ query: "Toyota" }) → E02144 / 7203.

listed_only.description: Only return exchange-listed filers (上場). Default false.

query.description: Company name in Japanese or English, an EDINET code (E02144), or a securities code / ticker (7203).

name: edinet_search_filers
